name: External notice or conditional approval

patterns_used: Use a controlled two-page form with explicit lifecycle, approvals, implementation, distribution, optional attachments, and retention metadata.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only approval, implementation, distribution, attachment, and retention controls; create the external notice basis, conditions, parties, dates, and layout from the new authorized world.

producer: Authorized external counterparty, regulator, lender, or approving body
purpose: Communicate a formal decision, its basis, effective dates, conditions, required actions, contacts, and referenced schedules.
medium: Formal native or digitally issued PDF with restrained external presentation
lifecycle: Issued final notice distributed to named recipients and retained

authority.governing_scope: Controls the stated external decision and conditions within the issuer's approved fictional authority.
authority.non_governing_scope: Does not control matters outside the notice or make recipient annotations authoritative.

authorized_inputs: Approved fictional-world issuer authority and decision
Approved conditions, dates, recipients, contacts, and schedules
excluded_inputs: Real-party marks, signatures, or regulator identity
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: The issued notice and incorporated schedules control within scope; recipient notes and transmittal context do not amend it.

natural_depth: Issuer, recipient, subject, basis, decision, and effective dates
Conditions, deadlines, contacts, response mechanics, and consequences
Referenced schedules, distribution, and retention identifiers
footprint.source_owned_rationale: The footprint follows the decision basis, number of conditions, response mechanics, and schedules needed for an external recipient to act.

sequence: Issued copy and delivery evidence retained

prohibited: Internal scratch marks on the issuer original

proof_gates.procedure: Verify issuer authority, recipient, basis, decision, dates, conditions, and schedules.
Render every page and verify continuity, legibility, schedules, and issue marks.
Inspect PDF properties, annotations, attachments, signatures, layers, and producer metadata.
Confirm computations are owned by separately referenced schedules.
proof_gates.not_applicable_rationale: The notice communicates a decision rather than executing material formulas.

proof_gates.procedure: Trace authority, decision, recipients, dates, conditions, and schedules to approved sources.
Scan text, metadata, annotations, attachments, and layers for prohibited residue.
Distinguish issuer decision, transmittal context, recipient notes, and referenced support.
Map every condition, clause, and schedule to the external decision workflow.
